text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Almost there... Just one more lap!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Nature... She seems to be overexerting
herself of
late.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Her last race must be bothering her.
Hmmm... In
that case...
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Токай Тэйо vs. Найс Нэйчер! It's time for a
pop
quiz!
text_block_list.name: Quiz Host

text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like we've got quite the audience. Ooh, fantastic! This is going to be exciting!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...Uhhh, Ikuno? How come you're giving
us a quiz?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
You're only going to end up getting hurt
if you
keep pushing yourself so hard.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: So I thought that perhaps if you went up against Teio off the track, you might finally brighten up.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Really now? Geez... You're letting your

imagination run away with ya.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Let's get started already, Nature! Better
brace
yourself though! Or else the
Invincible Teio will
best you in this quiz
too!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Teio, you seriously like this stuff?! I
swear, you're
game for just about
anything!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ugh! Fine! It's not like you two are giving me much of a say in this anyhow!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Okay, time for the first question. What is
the
name of the traditional Japanese
underwear that
covers the waist to the
ankles?
text_block_list.name: Quiz Host

text_block_list.text: Momohiki!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's correct! Найс Нэйчер takes the
lead!
Question number two...
text_block_list.name: Quiz Host

text_block_list.text:
"Don't count your carrots before the
harvest!"
And the next answer—that type
of ancient grave
is called a
Zenpokoenfun!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding! Ding ding ding!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow, you're on a roll, Nature! I need to
catch up!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер aces the beginning of the
quiz. But
soon enough...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Ooh, I know that series! It's On Our Fair Wings!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Ding ding ding!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Токай Тэйо's on fire with a streak of five

consecutive correct answers!
text_block_list.name: Quiz Host

text_block_list.text: Heh, how do you like that?! Now that's what you call a comeback!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
What?! Seriously?! How'd she close the
gap so
fast?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
She's practically glowing with
confidence. Well,
that figures...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Everything was perfect! I had the win in
the bag!
But that darn Teio just had to...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Dang it, dang it, dang it! I can't believe this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, wake up Nature! If I give up now,
I'm just
going to end up frustrated again!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
This isn't over yet! The answer is
sankin-kotai! The
Japanese pit viper! A
rakugo performer!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Токай Тэйо versus Найс Нэйчер—their
fierce
competition is neck and neck up
to the very last
question. But in the end,
the winner is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Incredible! The winner, by just a
one-point
margin, is... Найс Нэйчер!
text_block_list.name: Quiz Host

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...I beat Teio. I... won!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, sooo close! This is sooo
frustrating!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
...But you won't be so lucky next time,
Nature!
This isn't over!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
What the?! Now she's acting like the
main
character on her redemption arc?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: ...Geez. Her optimism's unwavering.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Heheh. In any case, Nature, you finally
got your
win.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Oh, Ikuno... Yeah, I did.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Still... I know I won today, but the
frustration's
still there.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
So I'm not going to rest—not until I beat
Teio in a
race!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
